pages.text: $(lilomon)$(#503a30)There's been me and my bro. our dad watches over us. We were both different, my brother and me... I liked making thing and keeping them safe, all cute and sweet to hold and boop.

$(lilomon)$(#503a30)Then there's my brother, who wonders how many pounces can bend something before it broke. Even if he liked to pounce on my things, he was still my brother, and i was very glad to have him.
